Name: CP-A -  Fire Katana (Hiroyuki)
Author: pilipino93
Description:
Replaces the Galaxy Sword with a katana set aflame!

I named it Hiroyuki after the notorious Ii family sword "弘行琳雅". No relation, at all, they were known for their crimson red armor so thought it'd match.

Make sure you got smapi, content patcher, and content patcher animations installed!

Downloads.Description: An animated fire katana that replaces the skin for the Galaxy Sword
